messages:
maggie: quick postmortem follow-up from the 03/18 inference latency incident — collated actions and a small SOP tweak proposal. TL;DR: add an explicit triage checklist item for prefix/KV cache checks, a short `hotfix` command snippet, and clarify escalation path from oncall -> runtime -> platform within 30m.

devon: SGTM. can we also add the `model-variant fallback` check to the checklist? saw repeats of that in two incidents.

maggie: yes. add fallback check as #2. ordering I'm proposing: 1) confirm scope (customers impacted, models), 2) check model-variant fallback, 3) check prefix/KV cache, 4) check autoscaler backlog, 5) fallback to smaller model if needed.

samir: proposing owners + timelines: devon to own runbook edits (PR by EOD Tue), anya to own automation tests for the checklist steps (PR in 7 days), lisa to own escalation diagram + contact updates (EOW). I'll track verification and close action items.

anya: noted. for automation tests I need the exact commands to assert cache health — can we standardize those here?

maggie: adding suggested commands to the SOP draft below. please sanity-check:
```
# check prefix/KV cache health (inference namespace)
redwoodctl cache inspect --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --show-stats
# flush prefix if corrupted (use with care)
redwoodctl cache flush --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --confirm
# confirm model fallback config is present
redwoodctl model get-config --model=redwood-alpha --show-fallbacks
# quick autoscaler backlog check
kubectl -n inference get hpa -o wide
```

devon: those look good. maybe add a quick `curl` to the /healthz endpoint to capture latency in triage: `curl -sS -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://inference.svc/healthz`

lisa: for the escalation diagram: propose a hard 30-minute SLA on contacting runtime after oncall tags runtime lead. add explicit phone/SMS step for after-hours. I'll update contact list in the docs.

maggie: one more: recurring incident pattern detection — add an item to postmortem template to mark if an incident matches an existing pattern (cache thrash, autoscaler oversubscribe, tokenization edgecase). If yes, route to Pattern Owners board and schedule a deeper RCA.

samir: thumbs up. I'll create the tracking ticket in our postmortem board and link it to the runbook PR.

anya: small nit: can we keep the command examples copy-paste-safe (no line wrapping) and add a short example output snippet for `redwoodctl cache inspect` so oncall has an expected shape?

devon: added to my PR notes. I'll include sample outputs and a clear "danger" callout for `cache flush` with a confirm flag reminder.

maggie: okay folks — owners and deadlines again: devon (runbook PR) by EOD Tue, anya (automation tests) in 7 days, lisa (escalation + contacts) by EOW, samir (tracking ticket + verification) tomorrow. I'll follow up with a brief checklist in the incidents board. ping me if timeline won't work. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Reminder: Created task INCIDENT-4921 "SOP tweaks: cache/fallback triage + escalation diagram" assigned to samir, due 2026-03-25.

lisa: noted and thanks — will update calendar contacts too. :phone:

samir: thanks all, I'll post the tracking link once created.

maggie: thanks team — closing thread for updates, will re-open if any blockers. :thumbsup:
